programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Spirit Day
programme.desc: Mega Fat CEO Baby holds a game day at Baby Corp and Boss Baby must find a way to beat Mega Fat CEO Baby at his own game

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S2 - O Brother Where Aren't Thou?
programme.desc: Mort becomes jealous when King Julien's wish for a little brother finally comes true after his parents adopt a socially awkward Aye-Aye named Brodney.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Caved And Confused
programme.desc: When Grug and Ugga leave the kids alone on date night, Eep throws the first-ever house party that rages out of control and almost destroys the cave.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Big Trouble in Panda Village
programme.desc: The kids must leave Po to escape into the forest and head back to Panda Village to prepare against Jindiao

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Adventure
programme.desc: Puss misses the old days adventuring with his buddy Jack Sprat. Fearful he will leave San Lorenzo, Dulcinea concocts a super special adventure surprise with the orphans. But Jack Sprat shows up with the promise of a damsel in distress… who turns out to be a super scary monster.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Federal Slumber Party
programme.desc: Uncle Benji makes a surprise visit to the Templeton Family with a cute baby of his own: Lil Bit Guerrero! Tina gets jealous of Carol doting on Lil Bit, while Benji reveals that in order to make his daughter proud of him, he’s applied to become a Federal Agent. With Boss Baby’s cover at stake, it’s up to the Templeton Family to get Benji out of their hair as he sniffs around for a case that could garner the attention from federal law enforcement.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Floaties
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Escape From Beta Traz
programme.desc: The paladins infiltrate a high-security Galra prison on a rescue mission

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Stayin' Alive
programme.desc: Allura returns to the Balmera to gather a giant crystal when a familiar foe reawakens

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And Her New Family Part 1
programme.desc: When El Circo Dos Grillos comes to town, Lucky and Spirit learn circus tricks.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Crocodile Has A Bumpy Back
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Crocodile didn't have a bumpy back. His skin was all smooth and he had to be very careful of the hot Tinga Tinga sun. One day whilst napping Crocodile gets very sunburnt and falls into a deep sleep. Lion warns all the animals to be on their guard as the Wildebeest have returned to Tinga Tinga and they could stampede at any moment. Crocodile misses the meeting, snoring under the hot sun.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Jackal Howls At The Moon
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Jackal didn't howl at the moon. He was a trickster and he always wanted what was not rightfully his. Jackal took over Hen's nest and Aardvark's burrow. He even took the cub's supper from Mama Cheetah! Enough was enough! All the animals decide to teach Jackal a lesson and make him believe that the Moon is made of the sweetest, most delicious honey in Tinga Tinga. Of course, Jackal instantly wants some… but it never comes.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - It's Go Go Go At Silver Hatch
programme.desc: Murray Walker is visiting Silver Hatch. Mr Carburettor would like him to commentate while the cars put on a stunt display. But Murray has other ideas… he admits he has always dreamed of racing himself. An unlikely candidate makes his dreams come true!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Heroes
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor's cousin Chubby is coming to Silver hatch as he wants to film his new blockbuster there. Everybody goes all out to prove that it is just the right location for Chubby's new film

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - PC Roary
programme.desc: Roary helps PC Pete keep the track safe on a snowy day.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Winter Breeze
programme.desc: Breeze is visiting the track. The beach is boring in the winter as nobody comes to visit. She tries her best to help everyone get ready for the winter festival but doesn't seem to be good at anything…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash The Marshall
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is going to ban Flash from Silver hatch unless he learns how to do something useful. Can Flash learn how to be a good marshal in time?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hellie's A Winner
programme.desc: Hellie wants to be able to race like the cars. When he does join in he is accused of cheating. Hellie is upset and the cars annoyed… will they be able to make up before something disastrous happens?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - Case Of The Broken Crystal Memory Game
programme.desc: All the toys are ready to start the exciting DareDale Challenge race, which culminates in the competitors successfully completing the Crystal Memory Game in the DareDale Caves. Before the race can start everyone is disappointed to discover that the Crystal Memory Game has been broken. Whilst Clockwork Mouse gets the game mended, Noddy must investigate who broke the game so that they don't break it again.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Amazing Eyebrows
programme.desc: It's the day of the Best Toy Award in Toyland and Fuse is the winner! He's very excited but when his new dressing up eyebrows that he wanted to wear to the ceremony go missing, he's devastated. It's up the Noddy to investigate who has taken the amazing eyebrows so that he can get them back to Fuse before the ceremony starts.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Hiding Pirates
programme.desc: Everyone is excited about singing sea shanties in the big Pirate Party in Toyland. But when Scurvy the Parrot arrives at Toy Green all on his own Noddy soon realises that the pirates are missing.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Music Player
programme.desc: Noddy's new music player starts a craze for the latest dance, the Toy Twist. He decides to have a big dance party that night! All his friends are excited apart from Smartysaurus, who can't dance. When the music player goes missing, Noddy must use all his investigative skills of listening, looking and following clues on the WhoWhatWhere Tablet to find out who has taken the music player and why.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Pat and Jess set off to Cornwall to collect this very large special delivery in the SDS Plane whilst Ted sets about giving away all of his old inventions to the people of Greendale in order to clear out enough space for the engine. Pat and Jess meet the eccentric Ned Glenn at his workshop and wrestle with the crate containing the heavy engine to get it aboard the plane.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Giant Pumpkin
programme.desc: Pat has to deliver some pumpkins to Greendale School for the annual Halloween Pumpkin Party. But when he picks them up from Ted's workshop, Jess starts playing with a giant pumpkin and it rolls into the river and floats away. Pat follows it along the river and tries to fish it out with Alf's rod but the pumpkin is too heavy and the line breaks. As the party gets under way in Greendale, the giant pumpkin floats out to sea and Pat and Jess board the SDS Orca and head out into Pencaster Bay.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Karmageddon Chet Gets Burned

Burn breaks up with Chet after he forgets her birthday. To make Burn jealous, Turbo dresses up as a girl and pretends to be Chet's new girlfriend.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Gypsy Moth Prophecies Skidzo-Brainia
programme.desc: A fortune-telling moth forecasts doom for Whiplash and though Whip is skeptical, the crew tries to keep him safe so the it doesn't come true. Skidmark learns the crew is tired of his crazy behavior so he invents a helmet that changes his personality in unpredictable ways.

Noddy decides to investigate who is turning the lights on. Bravely overcoming his own fear of the dark, he follows the clues to discover that the lights are being secretly turned on by a scared Carlton, who doesn't like the dark.

Amidst the chaos, Fitri, a security guard working for Devan, is tricked by a friend while trying to catch a thief who turns out to be Devan’s ex-girlfriend, Bianca. Fitri now faces disciplinary action for 'negligence,' caught in the crossfire of Devan’s messy love life.

programme.title: INCES JUNJUNGAN KITA SEMUA
programme.desc: Inces is a beautiful yet tough and rebellious tomboy who extorts change from drivers at a busy intersection. One day, she targets Romi during a heated argument with his girlfriend, faking a serious injury for 'hush money.' Romi sees through her act but ends up taking her to the hospital anyway. Their paths cross again when Inces is hired to care for Romi’s mother. Little do they know, they share a deeper bond: both were raised as adopted children.

programme.title: GURU KARATEKU KECE BADAI
programme.desc: Distracted by her own heavy thoughts, Andini (Ariel Tatum) accidentally hits Damar (Lucky Perdana) with her motorcycle. She manages to flee, but Damar later finds her being chased by a group of people. Even though Damar saves her, he's annoyed because instead of thanking him, Andini lashes out. However, knowing Damar is a karate instructor, Andini eventually begs him to be her personal bodyguard.

programme.desc: On the way to Graz from Vienna, Jolly makes an unexpected discovery: a medieval castle on a volcano, which is home to a dungeon of witches.

programme.title: Backpack Portugal - Lisbon, Portugal
programme.desc: From the tower of Belém to the Jeronimos Monastery, the sights of Lisbon narrate stories about Portugal’s maritime voyages of discovery.

programme.title: The Gypsies - Hanumantiya, India

programme.title: Burn Appetit - Graz, Austria
programme.desc: Set among the farms and vineyards of Styria, the city of Graz has quietly become the culinary crowning jewel of Austria.

programme.title: Off The Grid Ethiopia - Axum,Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline explores the ruins of Aksum, the heart of ancient Ethiopia. Next, she tries the Ethiopian coffee ceremony and hyena feeding in Harar.

programme.title: Xplore Oman - Wadi Bani Khalid
programme.desc: Apart from deserts, Oman also has majestic, rust-colored mountain ranges, which quietly hold the country’s history in them.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP15
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP10
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP16
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP17
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP9
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP1
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP11
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr - EP16
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Succession War - EP2
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP12
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP12
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr - EP17
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Succession War - EP3
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. programme.desc: 一部以傳統手工豆腐為核心的戲劇，將故事將圍繞著「萬家」的豆腐老店，雖然看似平凡，卻因為「一個家庭三個姓氏」以及「豆腐秘方只傳姓萬的男丁」的家訓，埋下了充滿衝突與矛盾的伏筆。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 熟年(台)第21集
programme.desc: 張春梅生活在外人看來堪稱完美，變故出現在倪老太太的壽宴，張春梅的老公、倪家的小兒子倪偉強居然無故缺席，而且電話失聯…

programme.title: 大雲時堂第12集
programme.desc: 廣邀政壇、商界等各領域優秀人士齊聚食堂，與主持人暢談話題、聊生活趨勢，把您想知道、不知道、感興趣的事如一道道好菜端上您面前。

programme.title: 名人書房第73集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 2024揚州講壇第20集
programme.desc: 秉持星雲大師以弘揚“人間佛教”為宗風，樹立“以文化弘揚佛法，以教育培養人才，以慈善福利社會，以共修淨化人心”宗旨，致力推動佛教文化，教育、慈善、弘法事業，將佛教帶往現代化的新里程碑。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1721集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.desc: 歡迎來到樂樂的飛行圖書館！樂樂是一個來自小行星的小主人，他收藏了無數好書。在這裡，有快樂、驚險、懸疑、搞笑等各式各樣的故事等著你。樂樂邀請作家和老師來圖書館，和你分享他們的故事，你也可以提問討論。現在就進來樂樂的飛行圖書館，一起展開奇幻又有趣的閱讀冒險吧！讓我們和樂樂一起飛翔，探索屬於我們的故事世界！

programme.title: 寶島西米樂守護第217集
programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第451集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 神奇故事屋第26集
programme.desc: 《神奇故事屋》描述在阿達叔叔的書房裏頭有一個奇幻通道，凡是在這個書房裡讀過的繪本，皆可以透過這個隧道進入到繪本的世界裏頭。故事屋就像時空任意門，帶他們到一個個不同的繪本中旅行。於是，孩子們跟著阿達叔叔進入繪本探險、拜訪台灣各領域的專家、破解歷史的祕密、跟著動物專家上山尋寶……，每一次的冒險都緊張刺激、精采得不得了！

programme.desc: 「水返腳」，就是現今「汐止」。當靜芬見到山田，才知道他們在這山區住了二十年，卻沒見過對方。心寬念純的靜芬，人生的功課，包括：勇敢的擁抱養母說出愛；調柔一絲不苟固執的山田；小學畢業程度卻能參加筆耕隊，寫作盲人與退伍老兵的感人文章登載於報紙，她的心路歷程，見證了單純能提升正面向上的力量。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第5集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 人文講堂第593集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第61集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第333集

programme.title: 快樂小蘑菇第13集
programme.desc: 這是一部以學前幼兒人文與品格教育為主的節目，從孩子的行為為動機，透國內外相關繪本為講述故事，藉由孩子發現問題來省思並靜思，最後再實現到生活中。內容分別都是學齡前孩子會出現的行為，如：搶玩具，分享，禮儀，害怕，不喜歡自己，生死，感恩，惜福...…等，適合全家，師生，教育工作者，一起欣賞…

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第61集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第188集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 水返腳的春天第36集
programme.desc: 「水返腳」，就是現今「汐止」。當靜芬見到山田，才知道他們在這山區住了二十年，卻沒見過對方。心寬念純的靜芬，人生的功課，包括：勇敢的擁抱養母說出愛；調柔一絲不苟固執的山田；小學畢業程度卻能參加筆耕隊，寫作盲人與退伍老兵的感人文章登載於報紙，她的心路歷程，見證了單純能提升正面向上的力量。

programme.title: 365日日素第129集

programme.title: 仁心慧語第481集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1096集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 行動現場第468集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第657集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1964集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第77集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第30集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龍寶刀再現江湖，武林各派你爭我奪，激起一場腥風血雨！武當派張翠山與天鷹教殷素素因屠龍刀而相識、相戀，成親生子，也因屠龍刀而喪命，留下孤兒張無忌。張無忌少年奇遇，修煉九陽神功有成！因禍得福，習乾坤大挪移脫險！拯救明教滅教之禍，被推舉為教主！排解六大派紛爭，誓死對抗蒙古人！。同時，蒙古郡主趙敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷離、波斯少女小昭對他的傾慕，讓他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，愛中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演員lt;br/>曾舜晞 飾 張無忌lt;br/>陳鈺琪 飾 趙 敏lt;br/>祝緒丹 飾 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 飾 滅絕師太lt;br/>黑 子 飾 金毛獅王 謝 遜lt;br/>許雅

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1352集

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第78集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第31集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龍寶刀再現江湖，武林各派你爭我奪，激起一場腥風血雨！武當派張翠山與天鷹教殷素素因屠龍刀而相識、相戀，成親生子，也因屠龍刀而喪命，留下孤兒張無忌。張無忌少年奇遇，修煉九陽神功有成！因禍得福，習乾坤大挪移脫險！拯救明教滅教之禍，被推舉為教主！排解六大派紛爭，誓死對抗蒙古人！。同時，蒙古郡主趙敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷離、波斯少女小昭對他的傾慕，讓他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，愛中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演員lt;br/>曾舜晞 飾 張無忌lt;br/>陳鈺琪 飾 趙 敏lt;br/>祝緒丹 飾 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 飾 滅絕師太lt;br/>黑 子 飾 金毛獅王 謝 遜lt;br/>許雅

programme.title: 霹靂英雄戰紀之刜伐世界
programme.desc: 中原正道領袖素還真為救摯友一線生，前往未知地域『刜伐世界』，經由浮動山城之主夢不覺指點，方得知進入之法，而夢不覺身上也背著與龍族的血海深仇，他又將對妖漫地獄產生怎樣的影響，吹響傳說之物君王贊的夢不覺之徒黃花落，其身份更是驚人，竟是龍族之後代，兩人又將會有何衝突！

programme.title: 我的女俠羅明依
programme.desc: 在明朝嘉靖年間，羅明依從小崇拜百年前下西洋的三寶太監，渴望未來也能航海遠洋。明依的師兄李時珍牽涉宮廷陰謀，遭到錦衣衛畢正追殺。明依冒險救出李時珍，與畢正在山洞內激戰，一道閃電降臨，將明依和畢正穿越到現代的新加坡……

programme.title: 霹靂俠峰

programme.title: 天之蕉子第30集
programme.desc: 落地哭三聲，好壞命生成，每個人都是天之驕子，且看這群天之驕子如何在逆境成長，如何改變命運，利用一擔擔的香蕉，創造自己的黃金時代……遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中，因志鴻幫秀玉解危讓秀玉暗戀志鴻，另外，志鴻的死黨柯忠義對秀蓮也悄生愛慕之情，命運無情的捉弄以及反派張瑞坤的撩撥，擾亂了眾人情感的一池春水，這五個花樣年華的年輕人，情感走向究竟如何？這是一個民國50~60年代，台灣盛產香蕉的輝煌歲月，南部小農村的羅密歐與茱麗葉的愛情故事，講述遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中因志鴻

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第50集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 包青天第78集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 落地哭三聲，好壞命生成，每個人都是天之驕子，且看這群天之驕子如何在逆境成長，如何改變命運，利用一擔擔的香蕉，創造自己的黃金時代……遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中，因志鴻幫秀玉解危讓秀玉暗戀志鴻，另外，志鴻的死黨柯忠義對秀蓮也悄生愛慕之情，命運無情的捉弄以及反派張瑞坤的撩撥，擾亂了眾人情感的一池春水，這五個花樣年華的年輕人，情感走向究竟如何？這是一個民國50~60年代，台灣盛產香蕉的輝煌歲月，南部小農村的羅密歐與茱麗葉的愛情故事，講述遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中因志鴻

programme.title: 新哆啦Ａ夢第185集

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第52集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第53集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 包青天第80集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 這是一個恩怨情仇，前後糾葛了四十餘年的故事。台灣光復前後，嘉義布袋大地主之子顏海豬、燒炭工的兒子汪邦雄，與佃農的女兒林桂蓮，這三個身分地位懸殊的童年玩伴，因為現實的捉弄而走上不同的命運。

programme.title: 華視夜間新聞第3275集
programme.desc: 為觀眾帶來當天國內外重要事件的報導和分析。無論是政治、經濟、社會還是國際議題，「華視夜間新聞」可能會深入報導，讓觀眾獲得全面的消息。

programme.title: 華視生活廣場第1461集
programme.desc: 華視生活雜誌將帶您尋找私家旅遊行程，樂活遊台灣，提供生活小資訊，學學簡單有用的DIY小撇步，一同深入體驗不同的休閒生活。

programme.title: 燈火闌珊第1集
programme.desc: 驀然喪偶的美香為完成亡夫的遺願 ，再造一塊他生前戀戀不捨的霓虹招牌，重拾昔日璀璨但遺憾的回憶。

programme.title: 燒第1集
programme.desc: 無聊的夏天，兩個小男孩計畫做一連串禁忌之事來藉此長大。阿傑和明凱鬼鬼祟祟地在小平房的屋頂匍匐前進，他們打算以偷看洗澡來完成他們轉大人的第一件事。成就達成後阿傑拿出偷藏的香菸和明凱分享，並隨手將菸蒂往地面丟去…而未知與意外也伴隨而來。

programme.title: 一字千金第1集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是台灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能制作公司制作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題并體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，并曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，并以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為范疇。至于答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 也好吃第5集
programme.desc: 與來賓一同造訪街邊小吃、家常料理餐廳，或拜訪各具特色的餐飲職人，從一碗麵、一盤菜出發，細細梳理食物背後的故事、時代脈絡與文化記憶；同時分享簡單易學、人人都能動手嘗試的料理方法，讓觀眾在觀看的同時，自然而然產生「想吃、也想做」的衝動。

programme.title: 也好吃第4集
programme.desc: 與來賓一同造訪街邊小吃、家常料理餐廳，或拜訪各具特色的餐飲職人，從一碗麵、一盤菜出發，細細梳理食物背後的故事、時代脈絡與文化記憶；同時分享簡單易學、人人都能動手嘗試的料理方法，讓觀眾在觀看的同時，自然而然產生「想吃、也想做」的衝動。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第946集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 全球現場-深度週報第12集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡明易懂的方式解析世界各地的重要新聞，並透過文字圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾理解複雜的國際事務。主要聚焦於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能夠清楚地了解全球局勢。

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第12集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地了解全球情勢。

programme.title: 看公視說英語第8222集
programme.desc: 公共電視與「大家說英語」雜誌合作，製作「看公視說英語」節目，其每日播出的內容均配合雜誌當日教學，透過影像學習英文，深入淺出，是各個年齡層輕鬆學習英語的最佳教材。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2782集
programme.desc: 單元多，可創造明快的節目節奏！不同的單元，猶如一個個不一樣的抽屜，彼此的區隔明確清楚。 多樣的單元，各有各的教育目標及觀賞樂趣。不一樣的孩子可以找到自己喜歡和認同的單元。幼兒的學習並非邏輯式的。單元式的學習方式，更能符合幼兒的學習與發展。綜合雜誌型態的節目類型，可以針對幼兒做全方位的生活學習。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第87集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第63集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原「公視手語新聞」改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目「手語資訊站」，用輕鬆方式「看見」生活新聞資訊。另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元「手語新聞通」，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語。

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第63集
programme.desc: 《公視越南語新聞》是一個針對越南語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在母語中深入了解世界各地的時事動態。

programme.title: 公視印尼語新聞第63集
programme.desc: 《公視印尼語新聞》是一個專注於印尼語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新的印尼本土與國際新聞報導，讓觀眾獲得全球時事、文化和政治等多方面的深入了解與連結。

programme.title: 公視泰語新聞第63集
programme.desc: 《公視泰語新聞》是一個為泰語觀眾製作的新聞節目，提供最即時和全面的國內外新聞報導，讓觀眾深入瞭解泰國和世界各地的時事、政治、經濟、文化等重要議題。

programme.title: 我的意外假期第1集
programme.desc: 寒假的第一天，小傑被母親送到遠在台南四草的外婆家。原本希望遠離了處處充滿誘惑的台北城，好動的小傑可以在寧靜的四草跟外婆學習怎麼安分過日子，沒想到四草反而讓他充滿新鮮感，好動的天性徹底釋放，更加不可收拾。早已過慣規律生活的外婆，究竟該如何跟這素昧謀面的外孫小傑相處？

programme.title: 水黽第1集
programme.desc: 西部公路旁的海水隨風流動，這天李玥漂浮在水面上，阿仁如水黽般姿勢輕盈的游向李玥，兩人緊緊拉著彼此。

programme.title: 島嶼 大自然的實驗室第1集
programme.desc: 深入了解熱帶卡加里、婆羅洲、斯里蘭卡、野生奧卡萬戈三角洲以及加拿大北極巴芬島和溫哥華島，揭示了當地動物如何適應獨特環境。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第96集
programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第58集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在台灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 換個爸媽過幾天第23集
programme.desc: 這是一個全新的親子實境節目，主題是探討一個有點衝突的親子關係。父母和孩子都希望改變現狀，為了達到這個目的，他們將參與一個社會實驗。在這個實驗中，孩子將暫時離開父母的身邊，前往接待家庭生活幾天。接下來，可能會發生一些什麼樣的故事呢？

programme.title: 喵的奇幻漂流第1集
programme.desc: 劇情講述一隻獨居的黑貓在洪水淹沒世界後，被迫與水豚、狗、狐猴和蛇鷲組成「動物版諾亞方舟」合作求生。

programme.title: 酷狗寶貝-引鵝入室第1集
programme.desc: 故事描述發明家華力士因缺錢租房，引來一隻偽裝成房客的危險企鵝費瑟斯，企鵝利用「自動機械褲」計畫竊取鑽石，忠犬阿高發現後展開智鬥。

programme.title: 行走TIT第298集

programme.title: 我們的島第1352集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第88集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 生命導航第2集

programme.title: 神選之人第10集
programme.desc: 本劇以精湛的演技與緊湊無冷場的劇情吸引全球觀眾目光，成功掀起追劇熱潮並贏得廣大口碑。透過沉浸式的敘事手法，帶領觀眾走進聖經時代的場景與人物互動，同時呈現一位真實、貼近且富有人性光輝的耶穌，使人們在觀賞故事的過程中獲得全新的理解與感動。

programme.title: 樹人大冒險第1集
programme.desc: 尤瑪想去市集欣賞漂亮的首飾，但是哥哥尤命顧慮她的安危，嚴格禁止她亂跑。被限制行動的妹妹非常生氣，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩開哥哥跑進了森林裡的山洞。尤瑪和尤命進入了樹人世界，而這次哥哥尤命卻被魔法命中，變成了「樹人」！憂心的妹妹只好擔起拯救哥哥的責任，踏上異世界的驚奇之旅！為了讓哥哥恢復原狀，他們必須從「鐵鋸魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在這趟冒險的旅程，尤瑪也將深深了解哥哥對自己的愛。

programme.desc: 我們去學校上課囉！動畫人物走進校園，去到教學阿美語、排灣語、泰雅語、布農語還有太魯閣語的五個族群語言的學校，跟著族語老師與小小朋友們一起上課、一起唱歌，呈現俏皮與新穎的族語教學方式。在課堂中認識書寫文字的發音，還有複習每集的主要單字。

programme.title: kardreseng把家蓋起來第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 石板屋－Balhiu不只是讓身體居住的「家」，也是靈魂的「歸宿」。Kucapungane的祖先們在這塊由雲豹發現的寶地蓋出蘊含精神文化與自然原理的Balhiu，做為留給子孫的寶藏。

programme.title: Kari Snruwan紀時光第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 帶你踏上充滿魅力的蘭嶼島，深入了解雅美（達悟）族獨特的文化傳統。 你知道嗎？當長子誕生，父母與祖父母都必須改名，這不僅是一項命名規則，更是對家族傳承的尊重與延續。節目中，我們將跟隨耆老的腳步，聆聽他們故事傳遞的生活智慧，從出海捕魚到追蹤山豬，學習在大自然中生活的哲理，一起感受隨興自然的島嶼節奏，邀你一同感受島嶼文化的純粹與感動。

programme.title: 出境事務所第13集
programme.desc: 圓福生命禮儀集團，是殯葬業在國內排名第三的企業，在競爭激烈、長時間工作勞累、人員流失嚴重的情況下，招聘了一批已有丙級執照的新人，希望盡速培養出在第一線工作的禮儀師，能在全省競爭激烈的殯儀市場中，取得領先地位。這一批分發到圓福生命三處的新人中，最受矚目的是曉恩，她能說善道肯學耐操還仗義執言，只是仗義執言這項專才並不合適禮儀師這個職業；第一天上班就與家屬起了衝突，讓曉恩的直屬長官紅牌禮儀師阿聖頭痛不已，兩人就此衝突不斷；心高氣傲的曉恩，即使與同事不對盤、被長官痛責、對酗酒的父親失望，對這個行業也沒自己想像中的熱誠，但為了家計，決定咬牙做下去！

programme.title: 嗨客嘶第2集
programme.desc: 《嗨客嘶》是一個以公路旅行為主題的戶外節目。我們將聚焦在台灣著名的「台3線」和「台9線」上，並造訪沿線的客家庄，探索當地的美食和秘境。節目的主持人是許弘霖先生，他被譽為「全台灣最年輕宮廟總幹事」，也自稱為「觀音金乘五」。他以幽默風格主持節目，創造出輕鬆活潑且搞笑的內容。這個節目非常適合在緊張的時刻緩解壓力，我們希望透過愉快的製作帶

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第321集

programme.title: 自學，學到哪裡去第1集
programme.desc: 紀錄因在台灣教育體制受挫而選擇自學之青少年，跨出教室接觸百工百業，從自身出發，透過劇場實習學習情感教育、透過劇組實習習得職業技能，進而從公益志工學習社會參與，並每集同步邀訪紀錄在該領域中努力耕耘的青少年。

programme.title: 六堆桃花源第1集
programme.desc: 300年前，一群客家人輕裝便旅，為了找尋一片新沃土，不畏風浪、辛勞，輾轉來到大武山下的屏東平原～看他們不畏艱鉅群立合作、自給自足農耕種稻、創建埤圳的智慧以及與各族互動磨合到共存共榮，進而形成「六堆」客家獨特的生活文化風貌…大家快跟著大獅兄家族，來六堆尋覓桃花源

programme.title: 伯公您好「神」第1集
programme.desc: 師兄家族四人在伯公生慶典前夕來到鄉下阿公阿婆家，並決定到美麗的山林與河壩探險........他們的旅程會有什麼奇遇呢？

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第24集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家庄裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第456集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第1集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(北四縣腔)第15集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 活力新故鄉第111集
programme.desc: 所有的不確定是動能的來源，故鄉的底蘊。活力新故鄉，故鄉新活力漫漫湠散中。

programme.title: 都市開基祖第3集
programme.desc: 捷運工頭阿財，帶領工班兄弟參與著隧道工程，為了讓女兒學音樂的他，以及各自有夢的工班兄弟，在開挖的隧道中，意外挖出一把詭異的武士刀，隨後也接連發生諸多不可思議的巧合；此時，臺灣首位女工地主任美莉，也奮力在工地陽剛文化環境中證明著自己，但她也因此，踏上了重重危機的旅途。

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第89集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1151集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第96集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 幕後有藝思第21集

programme.title: 嗨客嘶第3集
programme.desc: 《嗨客嘶》是一個以公路旅行為主題的戶外節目。我們將聚焦在台灣著名的「台3線」和「台9線」上，並造訪沿線的客家庄，探索當地的美食和秘境。節目的主持人是許弘霖先生，他被譽為「全台灣最年輕宮廟總幹事」，也自稱為「觀音金乘五」。他以幽默風格主持節目，創造出輕鬆活潑且搞笑的內容。這個節目非常適合在緊張的時刻緩解壓力，我們希望透過愉快的製作帶

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所第3集
programme.desc: 邀請各路高手擔任所長與您分享好音樂與創作心情，讓您睡前在美妙的歌聲中放下一整天緊繃的情緒，三不五時還會告訴你音樂小知識。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第322集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 自學，學到哪裡去第2集
programme.desc: 紀錄因在台灣教育體制受挫而選擇自學之青少年，跨出教室接觸百工百業，從自身出發，透過劇場實習學習情感教育、透過劇組實習習得職業技能，進而從公益志工學習社會參與，並每集同步邀訪紀錄在該領域中努力耕耘的青少年。

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第37集
programme.desc: 講述在特魯利城堡裡，四名主角的美食冒險故事，主角們的老師熱愛烹飪，擁有一本珍貴的祖傳食譜，按照食譜還原美食是他們主要學習目標，而在製作每一道美味料理的過程中，小廚師們漸漸也學會了許多人生中的智慧。但壞心眼的大鬍子阿庫伯總會出現費盡心思想不勞而獲，因此必要時大家會使出魔法阻止大鬍子的詭計，他們隱藏著神祕身分默默守護王國。

programme.title: 細細山路私密達第9集
programme.desc: 節目邀請五位臺韓主持人，橫跨不同世代與領域，在山路旅程中共同走讀客家古道。這不只是一次文化體驗，更是一場跨文化的理解行動，希望觀眾可以和藝人一起，用最慢的方式，去靠近一個族群的生命節奏。在古道上，走出一種新的理解，也讓那些藏在山路裡的客家故事，再一次被看見、被傾聽、被記住。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第2集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第15集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: 當晝新聞第97集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 《初心。登場》單歌第2集
programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登台。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第90集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1152集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 世外野人第10季:第7集
programme.desc: 班來到多塞特與前傘兵克里斯同住一週，克里斯過去五年都在英國的海岸線上尋愛，並募得了數千元的善款。

programme.title: 紐西蘭公路探險第2集
programme.desc: 英國喜劇演員格里夫瑞斯瓊斯的紐西蘭偏鄉之旅繼續進行。他從奧克蘭出發，途經科羅曼德與陶波，最終抵達威靈頓。

programme.title: 蘇柏金斯前進泰國第1集
programme.desc: 在本節目第一集中，蘇來到壯麗的泰國北部，探索美到令人屏息的泰北高地。

programme.title: 超級工廠的秘密第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 我們敞開大門，探究世界上最先進的電動計程車。美式足球如何承受相當於兩百牛頓的力量？在法國，一條化妝品生產線倚賴高科技的自動化機器人，而中國則持續以驚人的規模生產一種熱門兒童商品。

programme.title: 圖坦卡門失落之城第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 古埃及的法老為了獲得永生，必須在死亡前準備好陵墓和祭祀神廟。圖坦卡門之墓在近一百年前已經被發現了，考古學家接著要尋找的，就是他的祭祀神廟。但他們在尋找這座神廟時，卻意外地做出更重要的發現。他們發掘出一座巨大的古城。人們常說古埃及是一個沒有城市的文明，但這座出土的古城就證明了古埃及也有城市。王宮和神廟所需的一切，甚至是圖坦卡門之墓的寶藏，都是這裡的工匠提供的。他們造就了名垂千古的圖坦卡門。沒有他們，圖坦卡門將只是一具默默無聞的木乃伊。

programme.desc: 本集節目中，為了捕到足夠的漁獲量，船長們紛紛採取新方法。西北號的席格船長要聽從女婿的直覺，時光大盜號的強納森船長要探索海底深處，艾琳諾潔號的尚恩船長要向過世的老爸學習，傳說號的傑克船長則是要面對血親受傷的風險。他們能越過種種挑戰，帶回滿滿的漁獲嗎？

programme.title: 漁人的搏鬥第18季:第9集
programme.desc: 西北號船長席格在捕捉紅眼雪蟹時，女兒曼蒂也即將臨盆，而且疑似有前置血管的症狀，這個消息讓席格與他的女婿克拉克非常擔心，於是他們轉移陣地到靠近沿岸的漁場，準備隨時返航。傳說號的傑克船長遍尋不著裸蓋魚的蹤跡，因此他求助派翠西亞李號的利普，卻不慎讓兩艘船的魚籠和蟹籠纏在一起，傑克感到非常自責，最後用金帝王蟹的情報挽回合作關係。

programme.title: 西班牙海港護衛隊第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 一艘貨櫃船在巴塞隆納港差點擱淺，而一場暴風雨差點延誤了要從伊比薩港航向瓦倫西亞港的渡輪，阿赫西拉斯港的拖船得對抗長浪與強風，在半小時內讓一艘近400公尺長的船隻安全停泊。

programme.title: 西班牙海港護衛隊第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 帕馬斯港的港務人員正趕著把緊急人道救援物資準備好以送往西非的多哥，維哥港的港務人員必須確認漁獲數量，好讓魚市的拍賣會順利進行，塔拉哥納港則得卸下船上沈重的鋼材，好運往家電工廠。

programme.title: 為了媽媽去殺人第1季:第1集

programme.title: 風城改造專家第1季:第2集

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第9季:第8集
programme.desc: 來自泰國清邁的諾特去卡加立就學，離鄉多年後，他帶著想當廚師的芙蘿拉回到家鄉，希望在探索泰式料理之餘順便維繫感情，但他們尋屋的條件卻截然不同。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第9季:第9集
programme.desc: 本集來自加拿大的尼克與瑞秋想脫離原有生活，在柬埔寨展開新冒險。尼克追求當地傳統的住宿風格，瑞秋則希望家裡能有便利的西方設備。

programme.title: 整脊最上手第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 開朗的科隆醫師一如往常，用樂觀的態度處理各種複雜的狀況。雖然整脊無法根除患者的疾病，卻能緩解他們緊繃的身體部位，讓他們的日常生活更舒服自在。

programme.title: 免拆屋大改造第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 主持人利用案主家原本的平面設計，以不翻修為前提，改造出夢幻房子。這集第一個案主是一對要迎接第二胎的夫妻，艾倫與傑森。兩人過去曾嘗試自己動手翻修，然而完工之日卻遙遙無期，成果也不盡理。珍替兩人設計了各自的小天地，改掉地面段差，並營造出適合一家人的空間。改造後，廚房的空間變得更開闊，也更方便照料孩子。另外把主臥室的大床換掉後，整個空間也寬敞許多。第二個案主是戴洛與崔西。他們是再婚家庭，崔西帶著兩個小男孩搬進戴洛家。原本的單身漢居住空間，在珍的改造下，變為殖民地風格的溫馨住家。原本的兩間浴室，因為空間不夠，導致小孩常常爭吵，崔西也無法有休息的地方。而珍也分別為兩位小孩及夫妻二人增設合用的衛浴設備，讓

programme.title: 豪華原木屋第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 一直環遊世界的戴文轉型成在家經營自己的生意後，決定在維吉尼亞州購買原木屋定居，並請來好友帕麗和凱文幫忙看房。

programme.title: 豪華原木屋第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 戴爾和蘇珊多年來常到明尼蘇達州度假，現在他們決定在這裡的湖畔買一間度假木屋，離親朋好友更近。

programme.title: 貝琳大聲說第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 杜普利一家抵達倫敦！他們必須迅速適應文化衝擊。搭乘觀光巴士時，貝琳因過度刺激導致抽動症狀加劇。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 買家向艾莉森維多莉亞在巴克鎮的翻修屋提出全價出價，但是有個條件。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 尚娜與蕾莉在布魯克林找到一間公寓，兩人要在此短暫試住，體驗獨立生活的滋味。

programme.title: 修復英式莊園第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 跟隨建築師迪恩波頓Dean Poulton與設計師博賈馬夸Borja de Maqua，看他們親手修復一座曾屬於亨利七世國王、歷經三百年歲月洗禮的英式莊園。這座曾經宏偉卻日漸破敗的皇家遺跡，在兩人的巧思與工藝下，從中世紀風格重生，蛻變成夢幻莊園。

programme.title: 大廚荷西全家遊西班牙第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 荷西和三個女兒卡蘿塔、伊奈絲和露西亞來到蘭札羅提島。

programme.title: 問題皮膚救星第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 四名受到皮膚問題困擾的患者登門尋求艾瑪醫師的協助。

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 為了尋找可能已經滅絕的南洛磯山野狼，佛瑞斯特將爬上內華達山脈並在雪地追蹤神秘的掠食者。

programme.title: 野地刺客第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 從常見的蜘蛛、蜈蚣到罕見的毒蜥；從沙漠的蠍子到海裡的水母和魟魚，這些生物都有一項致命武器，那就是毒液。

programme.title: 野地刺客第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 動物的雙顎可能是牠們最要命的武器，有些動物的咬合力能達到驚人的一千多公斤。從赤道的熱帶雨林到北極的冰封平原，都有咬合力驚人的掠食者。

programme.title: 野地黑幫
programme.desc: 幫派不是人類獨有的特色，在動物界隨處可見。有朋友撐腰，不管是保護家園、尋覓食物、爭奪配偶、學習求生技能，甚至是宣戰，一切都會變得比較輕鬆。

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第10集
programme.desc: 兩棲類是獨特又奇妙的生物，遊走在水陸兩個世界，過著雙重生活。

programme.title: 汪星人的故事第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 介紹狗從野生掠食者轉變成為人馴化、甚至備受寵愛的過程。

programme.title: 大貓日誌新篇章第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 沼澤獅群的母獅們今天遇上了牠們最害怕的情況，就在戰鬥雄獅跑去別地方的時候，沼澤區竟然來了兩隻流浪的公獅，威脅小獅子的生存。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 《超能動物》探索棲息在地球上奇妙又驚人的生物。每一集主題透過震撼的大自然影像、漫畫風格的視覺效果，搭配不可思議的小知識，展現這些不同凡響的動物，巧妙結合自然歷史與流行文化，寓教於樂，適合所有年齡層的觀眾一同觀賞。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 揭示蝗蟲、水蜘蛛、大熊貓與皇蛾等動物，如何完成不可思議的轉化與變態過程，證明現實自然界中的轉變同樣令人驚嘆。

programme.title: 成群的殺手
programme.desc: 由於人類侵入自然棲地和全球暖化，很多動物的習性會因此而改變，有些危險的動物會大批聚集。

programme.title: 野地黑幫
programme.desc: 幫派不是人類獨有的特色，在動物界隨處可見。有朋友撐腰，不管是保護家園、尋覓食物、爭奪配偶、學習求生技能，甚至是宣戰，一切都會變得比較輕鬆。

programme.title: 河中巨怪-謎樣水域第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 據說澳洲內地有隻神秘野獸引起騷動，這條大魚把兩名泳客拉入水中，傑落米立刻啟程前往澳洲調查。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 喬治亞水族館原本有三隻白鯨，館方分別從德州與佛羅達州再引進一公一母的白鯨，組成更緊密的白鯨群。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 揭曉野地裡的最強爸媽，探究奇妙的育兒技巧和繁殖策略。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 傑克是一隻約一歲大的流浪貓。從牠脖子上的項圈看來，牠一定也是隻曾受到主人呵護的小貓。牠可能是在很小的時候就離家出走，或遭到棄養。因此牠獨自遊蕩有一段時間了，隨著牠不斷長大，項圈也慢慢嵌入牠的脖子，造成一整圈受到感染的傷口。獸醫很驚訝傑克在這種情況下還能活著，如果牠在長大一點，那牠很可能會被勒死。在醫療團隊的細心治療和照顧後，傑克的頸傷終於康復了。診所員工發現傑克雖然曾流浪很久，但並不是一隻野性難馴的貓，因此他們也為牠找到很有愛心的領養者。

programme.title: 汪星人的故事第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 介紹狗從野生掠食者轉變成為人馴化、甚至備受寵愛的過程。

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 芝加哥動物照管中心有一批鬥雞有待認養，穀倉收容所預定協助認養一隻，結果帶回兩隻—漢彌爾頓與史特勞斯—以及一隻白狗溫特。丹到克莉絲汀當志工的動物收容所認養回兩隻小兔子—帕可與諾瓦—作為自己的寵物。因為他租的公寓不得養動物，所以他只好另覓新居，剛好弟弟克里斯不堪農場公雞一大清早叫他起床，於是和丹當起室友。小牛迪傑長大了，不適合與小動物待在一起，改搬去大牛的牧草地。迪傑的好哥們—盲眼牛麥克—很思念牠，丹讓麥克到大牧草地與迪傑相會，沒想到麥克竟能適應與大牛在一起。穀倉農場打算興建新豬舍，為現有的豬提供更大空間，還能收容更多隻豬。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 在塞倫蓋提，競爭的本質就是狩獵，為了剷除未來的競爭者，這些動物的生活其實就是一場永無止境的競爭。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 能從競爭敵手的手上搶到食物，就不用做狩獵這件苦差事，在塞倫蓋提的草原上，常常可以見到搶奪獵物的戲碼。

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 為了尋找可能已經滅絕的南洛磯山野狼，佛瑞斯特將爬上內華達山脈並在雪地追蹤神秘的掠食者。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 傑克是一隻約一歲大的流浪貓。從牠脖子上的項圈看來，牠一定也是隻曾受到主人呵護的小貓。牠可能是在很小的時候就離家出走，或遭到棄養。因此牠獨自遊蕩有一段時間了，隨著牠不斷長大，項圈也慢慢嵌入牠的脖子，造成一整圈受到感染的傷口。獸醫很驚訝傑克在這種情況下還能活著，如果牠在長大一點，那牠很可能會被勒死。在醫療團隊的細心治療和照顧後，傑克的頸傷終於康復了。診所員工發現傑克雖然曾流浪很久，但並不是一隻野性難馴的貓，因此他們也為牠找到很有愛心的領養者。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 揭曉野地裡的最強爸媽，探究奇妙的育兒技巧和繁殖策略。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 牠們是頂尖獵人、終極生存者，也是長久以來被誤解的掠食者。跟著節目揭開蛇的祕密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇類多樣的棲息地、非凡的適應能力，以及牠們與人類之間錯綜複雜的關係。迅速致命的偽裝大師，蛇類是地表上最令人畏懼的生物之一，每年造成超過十萬人死亡。然而，這些被貼標籤成危害人命的掠食者，其實往往是人類侵占棲地的受害者，也因此才引發一連串危險而難解的衝突。《蛇的秘密世界》帶領觀眾深入蛇類不為人知的一面，揭露牠們令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 在塞倫蓋提平原上只有兩個季節，即乾季和濕季，雨水帶來新的開始，主宰生命的循環，大獸群在遷徙的旅程中生活備受考驗。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 塞倫蓋提的大獸群踏上遷徙的旅程，途中地形跟掠食者可能奪去牠們的性命，但是牠們必須踏上已有千年歷史的遷徙之路，抵達豐美的草地。

programme.title: 動物情深第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 芮伊哈維是一位野生動物保護志工。她在五十歲之前曾是樂團經理和活動發起人，但她的後半生和前半生卻大不相同。她在退休後成了一所野生動物中心的志工，因此喜歡上袋鼠，並建立了自己的袋鼠庇護所。在二０一九年的澳洲叢林大火中，她的庇護所被燒毀了，收容的袋鼠也都失散了。後來有隻名叫康酷的袋鼠回來了，牠還通知其他倖存的袋鼠來此避難。在袋鼠和芮伊的合作下，這些倖存的袋鼠終於能在此安心養傷。後來芮伊也重建了一座更新更好的庇護所。

programme.title: 動物求生策略第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 動物能利用獨特的繁殖策略，為自己的族群留下更強大的後代。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 傑克是一隻約一歲大的流浪貓。從牠脖子上的項圈看來，牠一定也是隻曾受到主人呵護的小貓。牠可能是在很小的時候就離家出走，或遭到棄養。因此牠獨自遊蕩有一段時間了，隨著牠不斷長大，項圈也慢慢嵌入牠的脖子，造成一整圈受到感染的傷口。獸醫很驚訝傑克在這種情況下還能活著，如果牠在長大一點，那牠很可能會被勒死。在醫療團隊的細心治療和照顧後，傑克的頸傷終於康復了。診所員工發現傑克雖然曾流浪很久，但並不是一隻野性難馴的貓，因此他們也為牠找到很有愛心的領養者。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 喬治亞水族館原本有三隻白鯨，館方分別從德州與佛羅達州再引進一公一母的白鯨，組成更緊密的白鯨群。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 揭曉野地裡的最強爸媽，探究奇妙的育兒技巧和繁殖策略。

programme.title: 動物情深第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 芮伊哈維是一位野生動物保護志工。她在五十歲之前曾是樂團經理和活動發起人，但她的後半生和前半生卻大不相同。她在退休後成了一所野生動物中心的志工，因此喜歡上袋鼠，並建立了自己的袋鼠庇護所。在二０一九年的澳洲叢林大火中，她的庇護所被燒毀了，收容的袋鼠也都失散了。後來有隻名叫康酷的袋鼠回來了，牠還通知其他倖存的袋鼠來此避難。在袋鼠和芮伊的合作下，這些倖存的袋鼠終於能在此安心養傷。後來芮伊也重建了一座更新更好的庇護所。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 牠們是頂尖獵人、終極生存者，也是長久以來被誤解的掠食者。跟著節目揭開蛇的祕密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇類多樣的棲息地、非凡的適應能力，以及牠們與人類之間錯綜複雜的關係。迅速致命的偽裝大師，蛇類是地表上最令人畏懼的生物之一，每年造成超過十萬人死亡。然而，這些被貼標籤成危害人命的掠食者，其實往往是人類侵占棲地的受害者，也因此才引發一連串危險而難解的衝突。《蛇的秘密世界》帶領觀眾深入蛇類不為人知的一面，揭露牠們令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 芝加哥動物照管中心有一批鬥雞有待認養，穀倉收容所預定協助認養一隻，結果帶回兩隻—漢彌爾頓與史特勞斯—以及一隻白狗溫特。丹到克莉絲汀當志工的動物收容所認養回兩隻小兔子—帕可與諾瓦—作為自己的寵物。因為他租的公寓不得養動物，所以他只好另覓新居，剛好弟弟克里斯不堪農場公雞一大清早叫他起床，於是和丹當起室友。小牛迪傑長大了，不適合與小動物待在一起，改搬去大牛的牧草地。迪傑的好哥們—盲眼牛麥克—很思念牠，丹讓麥克到大牧草地與迪傑相會，沒想到麥克竟能適應與大牛在一起。穀倉農場打算興建新豬舍，為現有的豬提供更大空間，還能收容更多隻豬。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 保育員訓練海獺吉普森學習獨立，不再過度依靠同伴。51隻非洲企鵝被移至暫養池，好讓保育員進行展區年度大掃除。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 揭曉自然界的偽裝高手，從微型刺客到頂級掠食者，全都是奇特的生物，展現出不可思議的力量。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第2集
programme.desc: 傑斯是熱血獸醫院的員工，蒂娜是他的愛犬。幾天前傑斯買了一包肥料，原本打算要搬進車庫存放。但蒂娜卻趁傑斯不在時吃了肥料。肥料中含有硫酸鉀，可能會腐蝕蒂娜的消化道。還好傑斯買的是有機肥料，其中並沒有強烈的化學藥劑。傑斯原本要為蒂娜注射催吐劑，但他緊張得無法完成，只好由佩特拉幫忙。他們為蒂娜催吐後，蒂娜的情況也穩定下來。接著他們又餵蒂娜吃活性碳，以吸收殘留在牠體內的有害物質。大多數的狗都覺得活性碳難以下嚥，但蒂娜卻吃得津津有味。

programme.title: 動物情深第1季:第1集

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 丹接到蘿菈的求助電話，她酪農場裡剛出生的小山羊後腿肌腱斷裂，希望有能力的收容所能收留牠，否則牠將面臨安樂死。幸好牠年紀小，復健過程相當順利，一個月後就能和其他動物一起生活。夏天的牧草地有大量虻群肆虐，母牛群和驢群都不勝其擾，農場團隊想出舉辦洗車募款的點子，購買大型洗車刷來讓動物們抓癢，避免虻群叮咬的情況惡化。母驢瑪莉皮特因為罹患蹄葉炎而有慢性疼痛，團隊用心替牠進行治療，所幸牠的膿瘍順利消退，疼痛也大幅減少。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 《超能動物》探索棲息在地球上奇妙又驚人的生物。每一集主題透過震撼的大自然影像、漫畫風格的視覺效果，搭配不可思議的小知識，展現這些不同凡響的動物，巧妙結合自然歷史與流行文化，寓教於樂，適合所有年齡層的觀眾一同觀賞。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 揭示蝗蟲、水蜘蛛、大熊貓與皇蛾等動物，如何完成不可思議的轉化與變態過程，證明現實自然界中的轉變同樣令人驚嘆。

programme.title: 野性尚比亞第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 尚比亞盧安瓜河谷深處的一處烏木林裡住著一群黃狒狒，狒狒群不只要面對外在的威脅，在族群內部也有危險，狒狒寶寶的生活更是危機四伏，灰白色的馬庫巴是群裡的異類，更糟的是，牠的媽媽尼瑪是最低階的母狒狒，母子兩個常常遭到霸凌，更有母狒狒常常想要綁架馬庫巴，群裡的另一隻母狒狒奇松妮剛生下兒子，兒子卻死在其他笨拙的母狒狒手上，孤寂的牠後來和外來的流亡者獨眼，一起加入尼瑪母子，這四隻狒狒聯手後，命運也開始轉變，未來的日子也許辛苦，但牠們可以一起面對，再也不是流亡者。

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第19集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片第1012集
programme.desc: 在艾克米建築公司，兔巴哥跟蘿拉兔帶領一群建築師，坦白說，他們都不應該靠近任何建築工地，但是，他們像團隊一樣合作，太菲鴨、豬小弟、崔弟還有其他夥伴，用他們的工具跟工程車完成許多史上最瘋狂的工程。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第57集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第55集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第1277集
programme.desc: 《少年悍將！GO》是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目。也是DC系列《少年悍將》漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗、嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活。本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現。
